body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> CrucialTec presented its new slim remote control with built-in ''OJ(Optical Joystick)'' together with its newly developed UI designed for IPTV.

The company said that conventional UI, which is being applied to mobile phones or IPTVs, doesn’t offer the full potential of the optical joystick''s 360-degree free-moving interface, and they will continue to develop an innovative UI for the optical joystick.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
